title: Microsoft Teams: voice phishing detection for external calls
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap targets and PowerShell control are supported, including Microsoft's warning that the setting currently has no effect. Minor corrections should acknowledge the differing call-reporting settings documentation, attribute the false-positive reporting instructions to the correct page, and use the review action for a new control whose rollout default remains unstated.

claims.claim: The prepare action fits the assessment scale for this new control with an unstated rollout default.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; defaultState: "unknown"; risk: "medium". Standard: "If nothing changes until someone chooses it, including a new capability whose default is not stated when no source says existing behaviour will change, it is review."
claims.fix: Set action to 'review': this is a new control with an unknown release default, no verified automatic change to existing behaviour, and medium rather than high exposure. Keep the specific review and communication advice.
